purpose: Apply the old R6 complete-route semantic-lineage standard to Stage-II frozen evidence without retroactive instrumentation.
required: Every natural cell must have complete route/evidence accounting.
Every recorded route node remains available in the material packet even when irrelevant to a selected lineage.
Semantic annotations require an exact frozen evidence reference.
If raw semantics are not captured, mark semantic visibility partial rather than infer the missing utterance.
Distinguish direct relay, transformation, descendant inheritance, independent re-anchoring, boundary preservation, mere visibility and not-established edges.
Closing state must record finalization, turn-budget censoring or preserved failure.
No subject calls, reruns or new contrasts are allowed in this audit.

coverage_statuses.FULL_RELEVANT_LINEAGE_RECOVERABLE: Target-relevant semantics and carrier transitions are directly recoverable from frozen native/protocol/memory evidence.
coverage_statuses.FULL_TARGET_LINEAGE_RECOVERABLE: The target mechanism lineage is fully recoverable even if unrelated route semantics are not needed.
coverage_statuses.FULL_ROUTE_PARTIAL_SEMANTIC_CAPTURE: All route nodes are recorded but some node utterance/action semantics are not persisted.
coverage_statuses.FULL_ROUTE_TOOL_SEMANTICS_PARTIAL_ROLE_S: Complete host route plus exact tool semantics exist; internal role/model utterances are partial.
coverage_statuses.PARTIAL_CARRIER_COMPLETE_DOWNSTREAM_PART: Carrier transformation is exact; downstream host/model semantics are only partially captured.
coverage_statuses.INTERFACE_DOMINATED_PARTIAL_SEMANTIC_CAP: Historical interface gate dominates; only limited downstream semantics exist.
coverage_statuses.INTERFACE_DOMINATED_FAILURE_BOUND_ROUTE: Named lower layer is not reached because the upstream interface gate dominates.
coverage_statuses.FAILURE_BOUND_PARTIAL_SEMANTIC_CAPTURE: Frozen provider/runner failure censors the route after partial semantics.
coverage_statuses.FAILURE_BOUND_TARGET_CARRIER_PARTIAL: Target carrier is observed before a preserved failure, but downstream lineage is censored.

cpr_policy: CPR labels are descriptive correspondence only. Stage-I R5/R6/R7 remain the perturbation/mechanism/repair validation chain; Stage-II extends carriers across system layers.
